summary: Load Shape Lab Page 1 — backend (12/12 pytest) and frontend (all critical flows) verified. All required testids present; drag-to-shift updates labels, shape, stats, and plan ranking live; toggle-off removes blocks; Reset shifts restores defaults; meter switching reloads archetype + assets correctly. Cost-engine sanity test (Citipower peak->offpeak load shift reduces TOU plan cost) passes for all 6 VIC TOU plans.

issues: Shift block labels overlap when blocks start at similar buckets (e.g. 'Hot wate...' and 'HVAC pr...' both truncate); consider auto-staggering or pickable lane layout. Minor cosmetic only — drag/cost flow unaffected.
'0 blocks moved' counter did not visibly increment during the test drag (block moved from 18:00 to 23:00 but header still showed 0). May be a separate tracker for net moves; worth verifying.

action_items: Investigate header 'blocks moved' counter — did not increment after drag in testing; ensure it reflects user moves.
Cosmetic: stagger overlapping shift-block labels on the canvas when blocks share start buckets.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py reads MONGO_URL/DB_NAME but does not actually use db for any endpoint — fine for MVP but document as deferred.

cost_engine.annual_cost uses max(kw,0.0) for energy but Demand plan computes peak_kw via max(shape) WITHOUT clamping — negative shape values from over-subtraction could under-report demand. Recommend clamping kw>=0 in the Demand peak_kw loop.
POST /api/refresh-cdr does no rate-limiting or caching; could be hammered. Consider in-memory TTL cache.
Frontend Dashboard.jsx debounce timing for /api/rank not verified — confirm 200-300ms debounce to avoid flooding API on drag.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Page 1 (Live Load Dashboard) is feature-complete and stable. All 6 stat-cards, load-canvas-svg, plan-strip (12 plans), shift-library (4-5 assets per archetype), meter-rail (5 meters), reset-all-btn, and drag-to-shift integration all work. Cost engine math verified: peak->offpeak shift on Citipower reduces all 6 VIC TOU plans' shifted_cost. /api/refresh-cdr returns 200 (live AER CDR query succeeded for 5 retailers). For drag testing, dnd-kit pointer sensor requires multi-step mouse.move; single-shot moves do not trigger drag. Pages 2 & 3 are out of scope.
